text: Field Ops and Billing have real Gold tables now. This video wires Amazon QuickSight directly to them, and only them, so a live dashboard finally replaces the old manual export.
Two rules keep this trustworthy: QuickSight's Redshift user can only ever see the gold schema, and the SPICE refresh is triggered by the pipeline finishing, not a guessed clock time.
One grant statement, one schema. quicksight_reader has SELECT on both Gold tables -- nothing in the curated or raw layers is reachable from this connection.
The last state in caldera-nightly-pipeline calls QuickSight's CreateIngestion API directly, so the dashboard refreshes the moment Gold is actually current.
The dashboard is live and trustworthy. Next: the real meeting where Finance and Member Services see August's corrected numbers -- and why nobody's bill ever went out wrong.
